(South Bend, Indiana) * [[Franklin Central High School|Franklin Central]]
([[Indianapolis|Indianapolis, Indiana]]) * AZ Compass Prep
([[Chandler, Arizona]]) | college = * [[East Carolina Pirates men's basketball|East Carolina]] (2021–2023) * [[Oklahoma State Cowboys basketball|Oklahoma State]] (2023–2024) * [[West Virginia Mountaineers men's basketball|West Virginia]] (2024–2025) | draft_year = 2025 | draft_round = 2 | draft_pick = 48 | draft_team = [[Memphis Grizzlies]] | career_start = 2025 | years1 = {{nbay|2025|start}}–present | team1 = [[Memphis Grizzlies]] | years2 = [[2025–26 NBA G League season|2025]]–present | team2 = →[[Memphis Hustle]] | highlights = * First-team [[List of All-Big 12 Conference men's basketball teams|All-Big 12]] (2025) }} '''Javon Unique Small''' (born December 19, 2002) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Memphis Grizzlies]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA), on a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Memphis Hustle]] of the [[NBA G League]]. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[East Carolina Pirates men's basketball|East Carolina Pirates]], [[Oklahoma State Cowboys basketball|Oklahoma State Cowboys]], and [[West Virginia Mountaineers men's basketball|West Virginia Mountaineers]]. ==Early life and high school career== Small grew up in Indiana and played his senior year at Compass Prep, averaging 11.4 points, 2.8 rebounds, and 1.9 steals per game. Coming out of high school, Small was rated as a three-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and was ranked the 14th best prospect in Arizona. He committed to playing [[college basketball]] for [[East Carolina Pirates men's basketball|East Carolina]] over other schools such as [[Ball State Cardinals men's basketball|Ball State]], [[Akron Zips men's basketball|Akron]], [[Indiana State Sycamores men's basketball|Indiana State]], [[IUPUI Jaguars men's basketball|IUPUI]], [[Kent State Golden Flashes men's basketball|Kent State]], [[Southern Illinois Salukis men's basketball|Southern Illinois]], and [[Virginia Tech Hokies men's basketball|Virginia Tech]].{{cite web |last1=Igoe |first1=Stephen |title=Three-star PG Javon Small commits to ECU |url=https://247sports.com/article/javon-small-ecu-basketball-recruiting-commitment-161754283/ |website=[[247Sports]] |access-date=March 2, 2025}} ==College career== ===East Carolina=== As a freshman in 2021–22, Small appeared in just 16 games, playing 9.2 minutes per game.{{cite web |last1=Ankony |first1=Jack |title=Oklahoma State Transfer Javon Small Hears From Indiana |url=https://www.si.com/college/indiana/basketball/oklahoma-state-transfer-javon-small-hears-from-indiana |work=Indiana Hoosiers on SI |publisher=SI.com |access-date=March 2, 2025}} In 2022–23, he averaged 15.8 points, 4.8 rebounds, and 5.6 assists per game.{{cite web |last1=Kosko |first1=Nick |title=Oklahoma State transfer Javon Small commits to West Virginia |url=https://www.on3.com/news/oklahoma-state-transfer-javon-small-commits-to-west-virginia/ |website=[[On3.com|On3]] |access-date=March 2, 2025}} After the season, Small entered his name into the [[NCAA transfer portal]].{{cite web |last1=Mason |first1=Patrick |title=ECU men's basketball: Small, Sunderland enter transfer portal |url=https://www.reflector.com/sports/college/ecu-mens-basketball-small-sunderland-enter-transfer-portal/article_ba0311e2-1c34-53a0-a2c1-7bf7a01e119b.html |website=The Daily Reflector |access-date=March 2, 2025}} ===Oklahoma State=== Small transferred to play for the [[Oklahoma State Cowboys basketball|Oklahoma State Cowboys]].{{cite web |last1=Wright |first1=Scott |title=How Indiana roots turned Oklahoma State's Javon Small into a 'very cerebral' point guard |url=https://www.oklahoman.com/story/sports/college/cowboys/2024/03/01/oklahoma-state-basketball-javon-indiana-roots-osu-cowboys/72807219007/ |website=The Oklahoman |access-date=March 2, 2025}} On March 9, 2024, he dropped a career-high 34 points versus [[2023–24 BYU Cougars men's basketball team|BYU]].{{cite web |last1=White |first1=Ivan |title=Oklahoma State Guard Javon Small Earns All-Big 12 Honorable Mention |url=https://www.si.com/college/oklahomastate/basketball/oklahoma-state-guard-javon-small-earns-all-big-12-honorable-mention |work=Oklahoma State Cowboys on SI |publisher=SI.com |access-date=March 2, 2025}} During the 2023–24 season, Small appeared in 31 games for the Cowboys, where he averaged 15.1 points, 4.7 rebounds, 4.1 assists, and one steal per game while shooting 44% from the field and 37% from three, earning all-[[Big 12 Conference]] honorable mention.{{cite web |last1=Callihan |first1=Schuyler |title=BREAKING: Oklahoma State Transfer Javon Small Chooses WVU |url=https://www.si.com/college/westvirginia/javon-small-commits-to-wvu |work=West Virginia Mountaineers on SI |publisher=SI.com |access-date=March 2, 2025}} After the conclusion of the 2023–24 season, Small once again entered his name into the NCAA transfer portal.{{cite web |title=OSU men's basketball's Javon Small enters NCAA transfer portal |url=https://www.oklahoman.com/story/sports/college/cowboys/2024/04/08/oklahoma-state-mens-basketball-point-guard-javon-small-enters-ncaa-transfer-portal/73243362007/ |website=The Oklahoman |access-date=March 2, 2025}} ===West Virginia=== Small transferred to play for the [[West Virginia Mountaineers men's basketball|West Virginia Mountaineers]].{{cite web |last1=Unruh |first1=Jacob |title=Big 12 basketball power rankings: West Virginia's Javon Small has Mountaineers climbing |url=https://www.oklahoman.com/story/sports/college/big-12/2025/01/02/big-12-mens-college-basketball-power-rankings-kansas-west-virginia-javon-small-oklahoma-state/77394410007/ |website=The Oklahoman |access-date=March 2, 2025}} In his first game with the Mountaineers on November 4, 2024, he notched 15 points, five assists, two rebounds, two steals and one block in a win over [[2024–25 Robert Morris Colonials men's basketball team|Robert Morris]].{{cite web |last1=Castrilli |first1=Nick |title=Small to lead Men's Basketball backcourt |url=https://www.thedaonline.com/sports/mens_basketball/small-to-lead-mens-basketball-backcourt/article_e82ef8c8-a07c-11ef-959c-9736faf8c4c4.html |website=[[The Daily Athenaeum]] |access-date=March 2, 2025}} On November 27, 2024, Small scored 31 points (highest in his year at WVU) in the matchup with [[Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball|Gonzaga Bulldogs]] in the second game of the [[Battle 4 Atlantis|Bad Boy Mowers Battle 4 Atlantis]] at [[Imperial Arena]] in [[Paradise Island]], [[Bahamas]], securing the win for the Mountaineers 86–78 in overtime.{{cite web |last1=Antonik |first1=John |title=Third-Ranked Bulldogs Bounced in the Bahamas! |url=https://wvusports.com/news/2024/11/27/mens-basketball-third-ranked-bulldogs-bounced-in-the-bahamas.aspx |website=WVU Sports. Men's Basketball |access-date=May 21, 2025}} On December 31, 2024, Small scored 13 points including the game-winning free throw, while also adding 11 rebounds and six assists, as he helped the Mountaineers upset #7 [[2024–25 Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball team|Kansas]].{{cite web |last1=Skretta |first1=Dave |title=Javon Small hits go-ahead FT with 1.8 seconds left, sending West Virginia to 62–61 win over No. 7 KU |url=https://www.theintelligencer.net/sports/top-sports/2025/01/javon-small-hits-go-ahead-ft-with-1-8-seconds-left-sending-west-virginia-to-62-61-win-over-no-7-ku/ |website=The Intelligencer |access-date=March 2, 2025}} On January 4, 2025, he scored 24 points in a 69–50 win over his former team, [[2024–25 Oklahoma State Cowboys basketball team|Oklahoma State]].{{cite web |last1=Unruh |first1=Jacob |title=Oklahoma State basketball overpowered by Javon Small, West Virginia in loss |url=https://www.oklahoman.com/story/sports/college/cowboys/2025/01/04/oklahoma-state-west-virginia-score-live-updates-mens-college-basketball-osu-cowboys/77455730007/ |website=The Oklahoman |access-date=March 2, 2025}} On January 18, 2025, his 12 points in the last 2 minutes of the game secured the Mountaineers with a spectacular win over No. 2 [[Iowa State Cyclones men's basketball|Iowa State]], 64–57 (he scored 27 points in the whole game).{{cite web |last1=Young |first1=Ryan |title=Men's basketball AP poll: Iowa State slips as Auburn survives chaotic week in the SEC |url=https://sports.yahoo.com/mens-basketball-ap-poll-iowa-state-slips-as-auburn-survives-chaotic-week-in-the-sec-182544875.html |publisher=Yahoo!Sports |date=January 20, 2025|access-date=May 22, 2025}} On February 25, 2025, Small posted 23 points, ten assists, and five rebounds in a win over [[2024–25 TCU Horned Frogs men's basketball team|TCU]].{{cite web |last1=Callihan |first1=Schuyler |title=Javon Small Proves Once Again Why He Should Be the Big 12 Player of the Year |url=https://www.si.com/college/westvirginia/basketball/javon-small-proves-once-again-why-he-should-be-the-big-12-player-of-the-year |work=West Virginia Mountaineers on SI |publisher=SI.com |access-date=March 2, 2025}} During his year with the Mountaineers, he scored 20 or more points in 14 games.{{cite web |title=Javon Small. Game-By-Game Statistics |url=https://wvusports.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/javon-small/17987 |publisher=WVU Sports. Men's Basketball |access-date=May 21, 2025}} On March 30, 2025, he officially declared for the [[2025 NBA draft]],{{cite web |last1=Centofanti |first1=Dante |title=WVU Men’s Basketball Senior Javon Small declares for NBA Draft |url=https://www.wdtv.com/2025/03/30/wvu-mens-basketball-senior-javon-small-declares-nba-draft/ |website=WDTV |access-date=May 17, 2025}} and was invited to the 2025 [[NBA draft combine]] on May 2.{{cite web |last1=Hall |first1=Christopher |title=Javon Small Receives an Invite to the 2025 NBA Draft Combine |url=https://www.si.com/college/westvirginia/baseball/javon-small-receives-an-invite-to-the-2025-nba-draft-combine |website=Sports Illustrated |access-date=May 17, 2025}} Small graduated from [[West Virginia University]] with Regents Bachelor of Arts degree on May 18, 2025.{{cite web |title=Eberly College of Arts and Sciences. May 2025 Graduates |url=https://graduation.wvu.edu/wvu-spring-2025/eberly-college-of-arts-and-sciences |website=[[West Virginia University]] |access-date=May 18, 2025}} ==Professional career== Small was selected with the 48th pick in the 2025 NBA draft by the [[Memphis Grizzlies]].{{cite news |last1=Neill |first1=Jackson |title=South Bend native Javon Small selected by Memphis Grizzlies in NBA Draft |url=https://www.wndu.com/2025/06/27/south-bend-native-javon-small-selected-by-memphis-grizzlies-nba-draft/ |access-date=July 5, 2025 |work=WNDU |date=June 27, 2025}} On July 10, the Grizzlies announced that the team had signed him to a [[two-way contract]].{{cite news |title=Grizzlies sign Javon Small to Two-Way Contract |url=https://www.nba.com/grizzlies/news/grizzlies-sign-javon-small-to-two-way-contract |access-date=July 11, 2025 |work=NBA |date=July 10, 2025}} On October 15, 2025, Small made his NBA debut with the Grizzlies, logging 17 minutes of playing time; in those minutes, Small notched three assists and a block in a 128-122 win over the [[New Orleans Pelicans]].{{cite web |last=MSN Staff |title=WVU in the NBA: Miles McBride off to red-hot start; Javon Small makes debut |url=https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/other/wvu-in-the-nba-miles-mcbride-off-to-red-hot-start-javon-small-makes-debut/ar-AA1P3tX6 |website=[[MSN]] |publisher=[[Microsoft]] |date=November 15, 2025 |access-date=February 16, 2026 }} On February 7, Small scored a career high of 22 points (7-10 FG, 2-4 3Pt, 6-6 FT), six rebounds, four assists, and one block across 28 minutes during the Grizzlies' 122-115 loss to the [[Portland Trail Blazers]].{{cite web |last=RotoWire Staff |title=Grizzlies’ Javon Small logs career-high 22 points |url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/grizzlies-javon-small-logs-career-high-22-points/ |website=[[CBS Sports]] |publisher=[[Paramount+]] |date=February 7, 2026
